verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's REST API documents three of the four steps: an available-slots endpoint, a create-event endpoint, and a cancel-event endpoint. Its official MCP integration lets agents find open times and book meetings from a chat. Neither the API nor the MCP evidence documents a reschedule operation, so an agent would have to cancel and rebook, which is a workaround rather than the capability. missing for 10: a documented reschedule endpoint or MCP tool, MCP coverage of cancel/reschedule, an OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of agent flows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can check availability, book, reschedule, and cancel meetings end to end through the API or MCP — no dashboard needed

citations.quote: Cancel event POST /v1/events/{event_id}/cancel ... Create event POST /v1/links/{link_id}/events
Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, or another MCP client to check your calendar, find open times, book meetings, and manage your links from a chat.
